rootCause: BattleShop, HUD and Overlay are design-stage-sized Sprites above the building layer. Their empty transparent regions intercepted pointer hit testing when the shop returned after wave one.
fix: Set mouseThrough=true on the full-stage UI containers and the bottom air-support sublayer. Actual child buttons remain mouse-enabled while transparent regions pass pointer input to placed buildings.
originalEvidence: generated/game.beautified.js:111520-111568 BattleShop.show unlocks building drag and BattleShop.hide locks it
